answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Gem cutter polished stone mark faceted in the cutting bench, proved by each polished stone is a gem weight weighed beside the maker's mark, checked by strangers. The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Every mask carries a 70 POA ticket that burns on use; 137 tickets burn 9590 POA, and the fire gives no refund. Take the nadir away and the name goes; take the garden away and the stake goes; take the voyage away and the past goes. Records never forget and prices never bend; the farm fails on both counts.
